ask: Keep project knowledge available across sessions and paths.
plugin: A skill plus MCP store indexes project notes and retrieves relevant facts at session start; hooks warn when a store is missing.

ask: Preserve useful context and control handoffs as sessions grow.
plugin: Function hooks inspect context and compaction events, save checkpoints, and load selected material after compaction.

ask: Export and retain local Claude Code sessions.
plugin: A bin command reads local transcripts and writes portable Markdown or JSON backups; a hook can make periodic copies.

ask: Find and label sessions consistently.
plugin: A command indexes local session metadata and offers search, generated titles, and rename actions.

ask: Carry Claude Code setup between machines.
plugin: A bin sync tool versions and restores user skills, hooks, MCP configuration, and settings with conflict checks.

ask: Use separate defaults for users, roles, projects, and worktrees.
plugin: Function hooks select scoped configuration and memory according to the active role and worktree.

ask: Keep chosen models and effort levels consistent by task and session.
plugin: Function hooks read task policy and set model or effort at request time, including resumed sessions.

ask: Use custom provider credentials and attribute model costs.
plugin: An MCP gateway or function hook routes supported model calls through configured providers and records usage.

ask: See local usage and cost while working.
plugin: A statusline and bin collector aggregate available local usage and telemetry, with alerts for thresholds.

ask: Stop repeated actions that consume money or quota.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook tracks repeated expensive operations and requires approval after a configurable budget.

ask: Diagnose and recover external MCP connections.
plugin: A monitor checks server health, auth state, and tool discovery, then reports concrete repair steps or reconnects.

ask: Require evidence before an agent claims work is complete.
plugin: A skill directs source inspection and a Stop hook checks that named validation ran before completion.

ask: Keep agent actions within user and project instructions.
plugin: A skill restates scoped rules and deterministic PreToolUse hooks block prohibited tools and destructive commands.

ask: Require explicit approval before high-risk operations.
plugin: A settings PreToolUse hook parses commands and asks for confirmation before dangerous database or Git actions.

ask: Create and clean worktrees and branches safely.
plugin: A command and hooks track worktree ownership, choose safe base refs, and clean verified stale directories.

ask: Control Git commit author and AI attribution metadata.
plugin: A PreToolUse hook or commit command rewrites trailers according to user policy and verifies resulting commits.

ask: Apply consistent tool permission policy.
plugin: Settings hooks evaluate tool inputs against a user policy and block or approve operations at the permission boundary.

ask: Keep sensitive session content out of unwanted contexts.
plugin: Function hooks redact configured sensitive fields before model calls and manage local prompt history retention.

ask: Inspect what context the agent actually received.
plugin: Function hooks record prompt assembly and expose a command showing loaded files, memory, and token use.

ask: Coordinate delegated work and its parent session.
plugin: An agent workflow and function hooks track child tasks, blocking dependencies, and handoff events.

ask: Control browser tabs and sites reliably.
plugin: An MCP browser server exposes focus and tab tools; hooks check destinations and retry limits.

ask: Adjust terminal interaction and output visibility.
plugin: Experimental function hooks customize Claude Code UI behavior and output rendering for key and display preferences.

ask: Show agent state and active working directory.
plugin: A statusline script and hooks display Ready, Thinking, and Working state and emit terminal directory metadata.

ask: Collect accurate local agent and tool telemetry.
plugin: Hooks and a monitor record request, model, tool, and session events to an OpenTelemetry endpoint.

ask: Deploy and maintain plugin configuration across projects.
plugin: A bin manager records desired plugin versions, checks local cache health, and updates installations.

ask: Extend and debug hook lifecycle decisions.
plugin: Experimental function hooks observe internal events and bridge them to plugin callbacks or structured reports.

ask: Load the relevant part of a large skill when invoked.
plugin: A skill and bin index split reference material into retrievable sections instead of inlining all content.

ask: Keep generated prose and comments within a chosen style.
plugin: An output style and skill apply explicit style rules, with a Stop hook checking the result.

ask: Choose how questions and answers behave in the terminal.
plugin: Experimental function hooks adjust question UI input and keyboard behavior.

ask: Create and verify Spotify playlists.
plugin: An MCP server creates playlists and checks library visibility after the write.

ask: Search and retrieve complete Gmail threads and attachments.
plugin: An MCP server calls Gmail APIs directly and validates full thread and attachment retrieval.

ask: Access repository content and workflows through GitHub.
plugin: An MCP server uses a scoped GitHub token to list repos, read files, and run repository workflows.

ask: Use approved Dashlane credentials in a coding workflow.
plugin: An MCP server exposes scoped credential lookup with user approval.

ask: Read and edit existing Google Docs.
plugin: An MCP server implements Drive and Docs API write operations.

ask: Manage Facebook ads from Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server wraps Meta Ads APIs with scoped actions.

ask: Operate Jira and Atlassian services from Claude Code.
plugin: An MCP server implements the requested Jira actions and verifies writes.

ask: Document stored procedures for a database module.
plugin: A specialist skill inspects schemas and routines and generates verified reference notes.

ask: Run ancient DNA alignment work reproducibly.
plugin: A domain skill executes pinned alignment tools and records provenance and QC.

ask: Build a cross-tenant isolation regression suite.
plugin: A specialist skill maps tenant boundaries, writes focused tests, and verifies isolation.

ask: Inspect and analyze system processes.
plugin: A monitor and MCP tools collect process metrics and report anomalies.

ask: Migrate Notion content into GitHub artifacts.
plugin: An MCP workflow reads Notion content, transforms it, and creates verified GitHub files or issues.

ask: Require deterministic compliance checks before tools run.
plugin: PreToolUse hooks apply the configured policy and deny noncompliant actions.

ask: Carry local Claude Code sessions between machines.
plugin: A bin sync tool exports local transcripts and session metadata into an encrypted user-controlled store, then restores them on another device.

ask: Control reuse and expiration of fetched web content.
plugin: A settings hook or MCP fetch proxy caches responses with configurable TTL and approval policy.
